programmes.d: A reporter finds himself trapped in a small town where the people have extraordinary powers.
Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.
In a future where everyone must undergo an operation at the age of 19 to make them identical to everyone else, one woman desperately tries to hang onto her own identity.
An astronaut arrives back on Earth, then notices things have changed in his absence.
Old Ben, who is able to transform himself into anything, tries to help a crippled little girl.
A playwright makes characters come to life.
A factory CEO replaces human workers with machines.
A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.
When a woman investigates a clamor on the roof of her rural house, she discovers a small UFO and little aliens emerging from it. Or so it seems.
Fortune discovers that a piano he bought his wife for her birthday has magical properties - the music that it plays makes people reveal their true essence.
A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.

Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…
Tight fisted Franklin Gibbs is not pleased when his wife wins a trip for two to Las Vegas. But things change when he falls under the spell of a slot machine that calls his name.
Little Anthony Fremont controls an entire town with his ability to read minds and make people do as he wishes.
A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.
The Earth's orbit has been changed, drawing ever closer to the sun and promising imminent destruction.
A used car salesman buys a car that dooms him to tell only the truth.
Patrick Thomas McNulty, a long-winded and self-absorbed know-it-all, is given a fantastic device which brings literal meaning to the expression "stop the world; I want to get off."
A Confederate spy is spared death when the rope meant to hang him miraculously breaks. Or does it?
A pioneer from a wagon train in 1847 sets off to find something for his ill son and stumbles into present-day New Mexico.
A plane lands safely, but the pilot, crew and all of its passengers are missing!
On a hunting trip, Hyder Simpson and his dog Rip dive into a lake after a raccoon. When he gets home he finds that no one can see or hear him.
A young couple book passage on a trans-Atlantic cruise, hoping to salvage their marriage.
A World War II veteran and a Japanese-American gardener battle each other over a war that ended more than 20 years ago.
A bank teller, Henry Bemis, longs for time alone to read books. He gets his wish...
